svg.title: The lidar
svg.desc: Photo of the TFmini-S lidar on a small mount beside the CoreS3, labelled. The lidar is aimed where the lens points. Its cable: red 5 V, black GND, green TX, white RX. The CoreS3 runs MagicFocus, with the Gateway H2 and DIN Base stacked under it.
svg.text: DIN Base are stacked under it
aim it where the lens points
